WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_county_province,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) as account_count
  FROM Accounts a
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(account_count) as total_accounts
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.state_county_province,
    s1.account_count,
    CAST(s1.account_count AS REAL) / s2.total_accounts as ratio
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.total_accounts IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.state_county_province,
    s3.account_count,
    s3.ratio,
    s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as diff
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  SUM(account_count),
  AVG(ratio),
  AVG(diff)
FROM step5
